title: Subjective Structural Intelligence (SSI): From Scoring Forests to Perception, Agency, Self-Models, and Worldview Evolution
description: An exploratory research framework for Subjective Structural Intelligence (SSI), extending structural scoring and control-plane architectures toward subject boundaries, embodied and situated perception, subject-relative world models, valuation provenance, structural agency, accountable choice, self-referential scoring, metacognition, and governed worldview evolution. The repository presents eight core research papers, three illustrative cases, and an agenda of open questions and falsifiable research directions. Proposed constructs are conceptual research hypotheses rather than empirically validated standards. Functional subjecthood is not asserted to establish phenomenal consciousness, personhood, or normative authority.
